mapper.select: SELECT R.RELATION_ID, R.SOURCE_DIMENSION_ID, R.TARGET_DIMENSION_ID, R.RELATION_TYPE, R.RELATION_RULE, R.CREATE_TIME, R.IS_DELETED, SD.DIMENSION_NAME AS SOURCE_DIM_NAME, TD.DIMENSION_NAME AS TARGET_DIM_NAME, CASE WHEN R.SOURCE_DIMENSION_ID = #{dimensionId} THEN TD.DIMENSION_NAME ELSE SD.DIMENSION_NAME END AS RELATED_DIM_NAME FROM TBL_BUDGET_DIMENSION_RELATION R LEFT JOIN TBL_BUDGET_DIMENSION SD ON SD.DIMENSION_ID = R.SOURCE_DIMENSION_ID AND SD.IS_DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN TBL_BUDGET_DIMENSION TD ON TD.DIMENSION_ID = R.TARGET_DIMENSION_ID AND TD.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE (R.SOURCE_DIMENSION_ID = #{dimensionId} OR R.TARGET_DIMENSION_ID = #{dimensionId}) AND R.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY R.CREATE_TIME ASC
